table.name: PAN_APP_SELECT
table.script:
# 应用选择器：扫描 midletapp 下 *.jar，icon 取 jar 内 png，每页 30 个 # J2meScriptLib 经 XmlExtAssist.addExtScriptLib 注册，脚本直接调用 sub oninit() def("pageSize", 30) def("count", 0) def("page", 0) refreshlist() ret
sub refreshlist() cnt = scanMidlets() def("count", cnt) def("page", 0) showpage() ret
sub showpage() pages = (count + pageSize - 1) / pageSize if(pages < 1) pages = 1 eif start = page * pageSize end = start + pageSize if(end > count) end = count eif clearList("LIST_APPS") for(i = start, i < end, i = i + 1) nm = getMidletName(i) addListItem("LIST_APPS", i, nm, "onappclick") efor setText("LAB_PAGE", (page + 1) + "/" + pages) if(page > 0) setEnable("BT_PREV", true) else setEnable("BT_PREV", false) eif if(page < pages - 1) setEnable("BT_NEXT", true) else setEnable("BT_NEXT", false) eif ret
sub prevpage() if(page > 0) page = page - 1 showpage() eif ret
sub nextpage() pages = (count + pageSize - 1) / pageSize if(pages < 1) pages = 1 eif if(page < pages - 1) page = page + 1 showpage() eif ret
# 列表项点击：GListItem 单击先 select 再 doAction，getListIdx 取到刚点的项 sub onappclick() idx = getListIdx("LIST_APPS") if(idx >= 0) jp = getMidletJar(idx) runMidlet(jp) eif ret
